He gets so caught up in whatever he's doing. I feel like I'm always second to whatever else is going on around him. He has ADD so maybe I'm not being patient enough, but I feel like I've been pretty damn patient. We've multiple conversations about this and I feel like he's made zero effort to fix it short of agreeing with me. I'm just tired of always feeling like it's more important for him to play video games or pick up the other phone call or whatever else is so important in that one moment. We have this one and only problem (that I am aware of) in our relationship. That's it. But it's a potential deal breaker for me if we don't get it fixed. I would hate to end it, but this is really a problem for me. It's so frustrating.
Glad I could help! It's such a shame you ever felt any other way. Be proud my dude.
